Name: Without Reins
Author: Quireeh
Description:
Go to: Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Farmer (before replacing, make a copy of the original 4 files). Then move the 4 XNB files to the folder and overwrite. That will replace the ones that apply the reins when getting on the horse and change them to hands free. I have modified the position of the arms to fit the witch brooms.

There will no longer be any reins interfering with other horse replacement mods! ^^


I made this mod because I got tired of seeing the reins when I got on the broom, among other things.. 😂 I hope you find it useful!! 😋

Downloads.Description: Delete the annoying reins that are generated by default when you get on the horse. No more brooms with reins ;P

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
